name: Shi-Ka-E-Shi
source:
Main character is forced to dress as female since the childhood. Now he attends girls school. One day his classmate discovers his manhood, and three girls start to bully him each day. Eventually he explodes and swears revenge over his offenders as well as mother and aunt who made him dress as a girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公从小便被迫打扮成女性，如今就读于女子学校。某天，同班同学发现了他的男性身份，三个女孩开始每天欺凌他。最终，他忍无可忍，发誓向欺凌者，以及逼迫自己穿女装的母亲和姨妈复仇。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
